The PB metasurface uses train-symbol-shaped meta-particles with varying orientations.
The PB phase is achieved by rotating the metallic pattern around the z-axis in steps of 22.5°.
The phase shift is proportional to twice the rotation angle.
The metasurface is polarization-insensitive, allowing manipulation of terahertz waves under various polarizations.
The frequency range for RCS reduction is 0.85 THz to 1.6 THz.
The maximum RCS reduction achieved is approximately -13.5 dB.
1-bit coding metasurface requires 2 meta-particles with a 180° phase difference.
2-bit coding metasurface requires 4 meta-particles with a 90° phase difference.
3-bit coding metasurface requires 8 meta-particles with a 45° phase difference.
The phase difference between meta-particles in a 3-bit coding metasurface covers a full 360° phase range.
The far-field radiation pattern is calculated using a specific formula involving the reflection phase of each super-particle.
Random coding sequences redirect the incident terahertz wave into numerous directions, generating many side-lobes with lower energy.
The maximum RCS reduction for 1-bit, 2-bit, and 3-bit random coding metasurfaces are -24.1 dB, -20.7 dB, and -22.8 dB, respectively.
The PB metasurface significantly reduces RCS for incidence angles between 0° and 45° in the 0.85–1.6 THz band.
The dielectric layer has a permittivity of ε=3.0 and a loss tangent of tanδ=0.03.
The metallic pattern and ground plate are made of copper with a conductivity of 5.8×10^7 S/m and a thickness of 0.2 μm.
The period of the unit cell is 75 μm.
The optimized geometrical parameters are h=30 μm, L1=20 μm, L2=20 μm, w=10 μm, and R=30 μm.
The reflection magnitude of cross-polarization is greater than 0.9 in the frequency range from 0.85 THz to 1.6 THz.
The maximum reflection magnitude of co-polarization is lower than 0.2 in the frequency range from 0.85 THz to 1.6 THz.
The meta-particle has three different resonant frequencies: 0.88 THz, 1.23 THz, and 1.57 THz.
The reflection amplitude values under normal incidence of x-polarized and y-polarized waves are greater than 0.85 in the frequency range from 0.85 THz to 1.6 THz.
The reflected phase values under normal incidence of x-polarized and y-polarized waves reach π in the frequency range from 0.8 THz to 1.6 THz.
The PB metasurface is designed to be ultra-thin and single-substrate.
The PB metasurface is suitable for both linearly polarized and circularly polarized waves.
